evidence.quote: They expected that economic conditions would evolve in a manner that would warrant gradual increases in the federal funds rate
The Committee expected to begin implementing a balance sheet normalization program in 2017, provided that the economy evolves broadly as anticipated.
Recent readings on headline and core PCE price inflation had come in lower than participants had expected.
Labor market conditions continued to strengthen in recent months.
Overall, participants continued to see the near-term risks to the economic outlook as roughly balanced.
Several participants preferred to announce a start to the process within a couple of months
